newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * The Romanian parliament on Tuesday started debates in an extraordinary session scheduled to last until July 10.
* Parliament's upper Senate resumed debates on changes to the law on organisation of the juridical system.
* The lower Chamber of Deputies started debates on a health insurance bill vital for Romania's plans to restructure the sector and provide improved health services.
* Teachers trade unions slammed the government's plans to amend a 1995 education law by decree, instead of submitting the changes to parliament for debates.

* Romania's Supreme Defence Council met on Tuesday to debate restructuring the defence industry and a four-year programme on producing and purchasing military equipment compatible with NATO standards.

* The government's control body warned that no measures had been taken against politicians and MPs who illegally purchased the houses used as official residence during their term in office from 1990 to 1997.
The government should issue a decree to set up official residences for Romanian post-communist dignitaries, the report said.
